newsitem.title: USA: Eisai gets approvable letter from FDA.
newsitem.headline: Eisai gets approvable letter from FDA.

text.p: Eisai Co Ltd of Tokyo said Wednesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has issued an approvable letter to Eisai America Inc, its U.S. subsidiary, for its Aricept new drug application.
Aricept (clonepezil hydrochloride or E2020) is an investigational new drug for mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease, the company said in a statement released in the United States.
Eisai America submitted new drug application on March 29. The company said an approvable letter is issued during the final stages of the U.S. FDA review process.
